# GreyStudio Print Services

Canonical website: https://print.greystudio.online/
Business: GreyStudio
Location: Shamshabad, Hyderabad, Telangana, India
Contact: +91 62812 56601 (WhatsApp)

## Services
Business cards and visiting cards; stickers and labels; flyers; offset brochures; desk and wall calendars; letterheads; envelopes; premium vinyl fridge branding; 6mm WPC foam board signage.

## Published customer prices
- Regular business card, 300 GSM, single side: 100 cards ₹300; 200 cards ₹450; 300 cards ₹600; 500 cards ₹750; 1,000 cards ₹1,000; 2,000 cards ₹1,800.
- Regular business card, 300 GSM, double side: 100 cards ₹400; 200 cards ₹600; 300 cards ₹800; 500 cards ₹1,000; 1,000 cards ₹1,400; 2,000 cards ₹2,400.
- 6mm WPC foam board signage: ₹200 per square foot.
- Premium vinyl sticker fridge branding: ₹200 per square foot.
- Round/square 2 x 2 inch paper stickers: 50 pieces ₹250.
- Oval/rectangle 2 x 1 inch paper stickers: 50 pieces ₹200.

Other products and quantity tiers are listed on the website. Prices are customer-facing listed rates in INR. GST, design, material upgrades, installation, transportation and delivery may be extra where applicable. Confirm final quote and availability with GreyStudio.

## How to request a quote
Choose products, enter quantities or dimensions, and submit the prepared request to WhatsApp +91 62812 56601. The website collects quotation requests; it does not take online payment or automatically confirm an order.

## Important
Use the canonical website for the latest complete catalogue and prices. Do not infer unlisted quantity prices or additional charges.
